nativeScope: DOM-storage getter acquisitions, typed Storage Access requests for DOM stores, four inspector DOMStorage operations and CSS paint-worklet module loading. Record synchronously before rejection or allowed initiation; discovery records attempts, not successful grants or every later retained-handle method.
ownership: Controlled native browser supervisor waits its original child and retains its actual exit. Fresh standalone recording attempts do not reuse browsers. The terminal verifier additionally checks original workload outcome, observed process-group drain, native writer PID observations and identity-bound journal/completion files.

completionProtocol.entry: Increment active before source capture or journal construction.
completionProtocol.commit: Append one complete bounded record under a distinct descriptor lock, close it, increment completed/violation counters, then decrement active.
completionProtocol.terminal: After physical owner exit and observed group drain require active zero and exact completed/violation totals. Synthetic normal renderer retirement cannot clear an unfinished transaction.
completionProtocol.fileValidation: Nonblocking no-follow open, regular file, private mode/owner, original device/inode and immutable attempt/policy identity; never recreate missing evidence.
completionProtocol.trustedBoundary: Private development process and host files are trusted. This is not protection against a malicious native test process rewriting both evidence channels.

limitations: The journal requires the recorded Linux x64 no-sandbox development configuration; it is not a sandbox-compatible product IPC interface.
Standalone ownership and application discovery have different scopes: application records aggregate complete browser lifetimes across original tests and are not a delivered per-test runner feature.
Two native writer PIDs in the Playwright TodoMVC four-worker cell escaped the 100 ms sampler; discovery observations do not establish independent complete custody.

These sources do not yet record every native painting dependency or host-only guard. Network subsets, other storage exclusions, full discovery and public test.defineFeatures delivery remain unfinished.
Discovery suggestions require review and do not prove future non-use. Structural property-presence probes do not become storage acquisition events.
The fresh-browser supervisor and recording operations change cost; no timings from prior pooled experiments are attributed to this implementation.
Final resource accounting, other-platform validation, release acceptance and representative majority-scenario 2x performance remain open.
